welcome.description: This is an example screen displaying that your language preference was successfully persisted and the interface is fully translated. You can proceed with baby profiles and healthcare features.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and create a secure password.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in using your mobile number and password.
login.pinNotice: PIN login will be available after PIN setup.

validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
validation.passwordLength: Password must be between 8 and 72 characters.

errors.phoneAlreadyRegistered: This mobile number already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.invalidCredentials: The mobile number or password is incorrect.
errors.network: Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

create.title: Create a 4-digit PIN
create.subtitle: Use this PIN for faster login.

login.title: Log in with PIN
login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and 4-digit PIN.
login.forgotPinNotice: Forgot your PIN? Log in with your password.
login.pinNotConfigured: PIN login is not set up for this account. Log in with your password first.

validation.pinDigits: PIN must contain exactly four digits.
validation.mismatch: The PINs do not match. Please try again.
validation.weakPin: This PIN is easy to guess.

mother.title: Mother’s Details
mother.subtitle: Please complete the mother’s demographic information.
mother.prevPretermEducation: Previously received education about preterm care?

baby.title: Baby’s Details
baby.subtitle: Enter the information from the NICU discharge record.

hospital.title: Enter Hospital Code
hospital.subtitle: This code is provided by the study coordinator.

complete.title: You’re all set!
complete.subtitle: Your account and study enrolment are ready.
complete.infoMessage: SnehoAyu will support you and your baby throughout the next six months.

validation.familyCountInvalid: Family members count must be an integer between 1 and 30.
validation.contactInvalid: Contact number must be a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
validation.sourceRequired: At least one source of information must be selected.
validation.babyNameLength: Baby name must not exceed 100 characters.
validation.futureDate: Date must not be in the future.
validation.dischargeBeforeBirth: Discharge date must not be earlier than birth date.
validation.gaInvalid: Gestational age must be between 24.0 and 36.9 weeks (at most one decimal place).
validation.birthWeightInvalid: Birth weight must be between 400 and 4000 grams.
validation.dischargeWeightInvalid: Discharge weight must be between 400 and 5000 grams.
validation.nicuStayInvalid: NICU stay must be between 1 and 120 days.
validation.hospitalCodeFormat: Hospital code must contain only letters and numbers, between 2 and 10 characters.

errors.motherProfileRequired: Mother profile is required. Please fill it out first.
errors.babyProfileRequired: Baby profile is required. Please fill it out first.
errors.studyGroupRequired: The researcher must assign the study group before onboarding can be completed.
errors.hospitalEnrollmentClosed: Enrolment at this hospital is currently closed.
errors.hospitalLinkLocked: The hospital cannot be changed after a participant code is assigned.
